name: bld5_hardy_sqrt_two_rec_defect_means
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) : ∑' k : ℕ, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2 - a i)) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.pi ^ 4 / 15
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_hardy_inequality_tsum, Mathlib2.bld_sqrt_two_rec_rate and Mathlib2.ana_sqrt_two_rec_lt_two: by ana_sqrt_two_rec_lt_two and bld_sqrt_two_rec_rate, 0 ≤ 2 − a_k ≤ π²/4^(k+1), so (2 − a_k)² ≤ π⁴/16^(k+1), which is summable (geometric) with sum π⁴/15 (tsum_geometric_of_lt_one, tsum_le_tsum). Hardy's inequality bld2_hardy_inequality_tsum applied to the defect sequence bounds the left side by 4·∑'(2 − a_k)² ≤ 4π⁴/15.
